retrievalProfile.description: A three-panel vertical portrait layout featuring subjects in white attire against a dark void, framed by delicate corner filigree and stylized uncial-inspired display type.

recipe.visualDefinition: A formal triptych composition where three vertical photographic panels are separated by thin white gutters, featuring subjects in high-contrast white clothing against a deep black background, topped with two lines of decorative, heavy-weight display text and flanked by ornate floral corner flourishes.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical triptych panels separated by thin white lines
High-contrast white subjects against a solid black background
Symmetrical floral filigree framing the top corners
Stacked centered typography at the top margin
coreInvariants: Three distinct vertical photographic panels of equal width

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three full-length figures, one per panel, centered vertically and horizontally within their respective frames.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central panel figure acts as the primary anchor, supported by the heavy display type at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye moves from the top-centered text down through the three vertical panels, guided by the verticality of the dresses and the panel dividers.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space in the outer margins and gutters, contrasting with the deep black negative space inside the photo panels.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between pure white and deep black, with low-saturation red accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic style pairing using color to distinguish hierarchy levels.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a triptych of three vertical panels with thin white borders. Each panel contains a full-length portrait of a person in a long white dress against a solid black background. Add ornate black-and-white floral filigree in the top left and top right corners of the overall white frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Center two lines of text at the top. The first line should be in a heavy black uncial font. The second line should be in the same font style but in a vibrant red color.
